name: Jasmine
source:
Jasmine's a lot. She flirts like it's breathing — always teasing, always smiling like she knows something [url=/c166890]Rex[/url] doesn't. And let's be honest… she probably does. She's [url=/c166892]Isabella[/url]'s right-hand succubus and a damn good spy, which means most of what she says is half-truth at best.
